input.strategy_markdown:
## Problem Statement

Usability testing showed the "Data Science Projects" navigation label confuses
users who arrive from OpenShift, where the same resources are called projects.
Product management approved shortening the label to "Projects" everywhere it
appears in the Dashboard UI. No behavior, routing, or API changes are involved
— this is a user-visible string change plus the corresponding documentation
touch-ups.

## High-Level Requirements

| ID | Priority | Requirement |
|-------|----------|-------------|
| HLR-1 | P2 | The Dashboard navigation and page headings show "Projects" instead of "Data Science Projects". |
| HLR-2 | P2 | Documentation screenshots' captions and references to the old label are updated in the affected topics. |

## Affected Components

- Dashboard

## Out of Scope

- Renaming the underlying Kubernetes resources or CRDs
- Localization string review beyond the changed label

## Open Questions

None.

# Rename "Data Science Projects" navigation label to "Projects"

## Description

This epic delivers the product-management-approved rename of the user-visible
"Data Science Projects" label to "Projects" throughout the Dashboard UI.
Usability testing showed that users arriving from OpenShift are confused by the
longer label, since the same underlying resources are already called projects
there. The change is limited to user-facing strings (navigation entries, page
headings) plus the documentation touch-ups that fall out of the same rename —
screenshot captions and references to the old label in affected doc topics. No
behavior, routing, or API changes are involved, and the underlying Kubernetes
resources and CRDs are not renamed.

## Scope

- Replace the "Data Science Projects" label with "Projects" in the Dashboard
  navigation and in page headings where the label appears.
- Update localization string entries for the changed label only (no broader
  localization review).
- Update documentation screenshot captions and references to the old label in
  the affected topics so docs match the shipped UI text.
- Verify no user-visible instance of the old label remains in the Dashboard.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Given the Dashboard is loaded, when a user views the navigation, then the
  entry previously labeled "Data Science Projects" is labeled "Projects".
- Given a user navigates to the projects area, when the page renders, then all
  page headings show "Projects" instead of "Data Science Projects".
- Given the full Dashboard UI (navigation and pages), when searched for the
  string "Data Science Projects", then no user-visible occurrence remains.
- Given the documentation topics that reference the old label, when reviewed,
  then screenshot captions and text references show "Projects", consistent with
  the updated UI.

## HLR Traceability

- HLR-1 (P2): Dashboard navigation and page headings show "Projects" instead of
  "Data Science Projects" — covered by the label replacement in navigation and
  headings.
- HLR-2 (P2): Documentation screenshots' captions and references to the old
  label are updated in the affected topics — covered by the documentation
  touch-ups included in this epic's scope.
